# mooncake mod

Manage Git-native component modules

## Subcommands

- [add](mod_add.md) — Fetch a module and add it to the playbook's modules: block
- [cache](mod_cache.md) — Inspect and clean the on-disk module cache
- [list](mod_list.md) — List the modules a playbook declares, with cache and lock state
- [tidy](mod_tidy.md) — Fetch every declared module and pin its hash in mooncake.modules.lock
- [verify](mod_verify.md) — Re-hash every locked module and report drift
